description: This file defines a set of tools for interacting with the Google Calendar API, including schemas for various operations, classes implementing the tools, and a factory function to create tools based on specified actions.

classes.name: BaseGoogleCalendarTool
classes.description: Base class for Google Calendar tools, providing request handling with authentication.

classes.name: ListEventsTool
classes.description: Tool to list events from a Google Calendar.

classes.name: CreateEventTool
classes.description: Tool to create a new event in Google Calendar.

classes.name: GetEventTool
classes.description: Tool to retrieve a specific event from Google Calendar.

classes.name: UpdateEventTool
classes.description: Tool to update an existing event in Google Calendar.

classes.name: DeleteEventTool
classes.description: Tool to delete an event from Google Calendar.

classes.name: QuickAddEventTool
classes.description: Tool to quickly add an event using natural language.

classes.name: CreateCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to create a new calendar.

classes.name: GetCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to retrieve a specific calendar.

classes.name: UpdateCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to update an existing calendar.

classes.name: ClearCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool to clear all events from a calendar.

classes.name: QueryFreebusyTool
classes.description: Tool to query free/busy information for calendars.

methods.name: makeGoogleCalendarRequest
methods.description: Method to perform authenticated requests to Google Calendar API.

methods.name: createGoogleCalendarTools
methods.description: Factory function to create Google Calendar tools based on specified actions.
